# Splash whole-graph integration

All three stable-ID lanes were reviewed together before original native cases.
runtime-planning owns formats, floors and memory/precision controls; serving-cache
owns salt/composite-state/disk/API/security lifetimes; qualification owns DFlash2
commit/reproducibility and measurement. Runtime files and helpers are complete;
no successful subset is passed off as full coverage. Lane material authors are
Codex runtime_memory_author, serving_state_author and qualification_author; root
integration author approved_arex_author. All inherit actual gpt-6.1-sol xhigh.

Root/sibling routes and internal links resolve. Every primary selected route has
nearby concrete contracts and troubleshooting. Safe byte parsing, request JSON
and descriptive ABBA reduction are bundled; model/client installers and native
benchmark/release harnesses remain reference-only/excluded for their real external
side effects. The ABBA helper drops upstream fixed verdict thresholds.

Only selected source bodies are covered: full kernels/formats, every release
path, native agent clients and supported-device QA are explicit long-tail gaps.
Python LRU/protocol/budget checks are not C++ cache, Metal/ANE, actual SSD/model,
quality, service or behavioral efficacy evidence. Required native capability
remains BLOCKED_REQUIRED_BACKEND, not optional. Final candidate admission is
manual and pending after actual verification, not granted by partial drafting.

Preparation used a private Python3.12.14 environment, pip check and explicit
isolated source-module imports/signatures: LRUCache(budget_bytes, capacity=None),
memoized(cache, lock, key, compute), protocol version11. No installed Python
distribution is fabricated. No Metal build or model was attempted on Linux.
